resources.string: Off controls use grey instead of a slash, retaining the same icon size and alignment. Automatic Location is grey too.
Compact landscape places Objects, Location, Guides and 0–24 on the left, with axis/weather or camera transparency/zoom on the right.
Camera sits above Capture and points/antipodes below Menu. Both side groups centre between their corner buttons.
The shutter border pulses from theme blue/cyan to neutral outline grey over 3.2 seconds. A static border remains visible with animations off.
Visual weather is on by default while saved choices are respected. Weather retries stay hidden when weather is off or the camera is active.
Hidden preview Labels and Position are grey. Label options are reordered without changing the saved choice.
